name: ChartKit benchmarks

core.note: Phase 2 head the timings were taken on. This docs branch does not contain that commit.

reproduce: Median of 5, Playwright Chromium, a 640×360 line, three x spacings. This file does not re-time the libraries.

methodology.browser: Playwright Chromium, a 640×360 line, median of 5. Shapes are even x, jittered x, and gapped timestamps. ChartKit initial is mount(); the aligned update is mount().update().
methodology.updates: The aligned update starts at the top of a requestAnimationFrame. The harness awaits the library's own completion, then reads the clock from a MessageChannel task after that frame's style, layout, and paint. GPU and raster time is not in the number. ChartKit is measured through mount(element, spec).update(spec), the same shape as uPlot's setData. The figure is the median of five samples.
methodology.sampling: mark.sampling defaults to auto and minmax-downsamples a line longer than twice the plot width. 1,000 points stay complete. The samplingNone rows draw every point and use the same aligned update timer.
methodology.bundle: Phase 4 per-type gzip from bench/results/bundle.json. esbuild minify, gzip level 9. ChartKit is createRenderer of that chart. /all is one bundle. unsupported and not tree-shakeable are labeled. uPlot’s JS and stylesheet are separate responses.
methodology.ssr: Phase 4 per-type Node render from bench/results/ssr.json. Median of 5 at the paint-matrix N. unsupported, error, and timeout are labeled. A blank cell is not used.
methodology.agents: Round 6 is the scoreboard. claude-sonnet-4-5, temperature 0, 42 tasks, one run on 2026-10-16. Not re-run for round 13. Official means the library docs were in the prompt. ChartKit docs are llms.txt. repair() is a no-model step on ChartKit's no-docs first try and is not a second model call. Nivo and uPlot were not in the agent eval.

headline.otherFigures: browser rows are round 13, measured 2026-10-18 on phase 2 d8dcc5a. Bundle and SSR are the phase 4 matrices.
